content: अशौचम् .²1 Impurity, dirtiness, foulness; <ls>Pt. 1. 195</ls>. .²2 Legal impurity or contamination; defilement caused either by child-birth (called जननाशौच) or by the death of some relation (called मृताशौच); it lasts for 10 days; during the मृताशौच a person defiled by it is not to touch anybody else, or to eat with others in the same row or to do any sacred action; अहोरात्रमुपासीरन्नशौचं बान्धवैः सह <ls>Ms. 11. 183</ls>.
